overview: The Climate Equity Council reviewed upcoming community events, discussed summer heat preparedness resources and waste reduction initiatives, and received a detailed update on city bicycle, pedestrian, and transit infrastructure.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The council approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Future Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The council set its next meeting date for June 24, 2026.

items.title: Community Events and Member Updates
items.summary: Members reviewed upcoming community events, including a free flea market, a mini-forest site prep day, an EV charger ribbon cutting, and planned community garden workshops.

items.title: Summer Heat Preparedness and Cooling Resources
items.summary: The council discussed creating outreach materials and mapping city cooling resources such as splash pads, pools, and water fountains.

items.title: Electrify Medford and Energy & Environment Committee Updates
items.summary: Staff shared Electrify Medford participation numbers, and an Energy and Environment Committee update covered proposed black plastic bans, Pay-As-You-Throw trash concepts, and recycling educational games.

items.title: Transportation and Pedestrian Infrastructure Update
items.summary: Transportation Director Todd Blake presented updates on MBTA bus service advocacy, Blue Bikes station expansions, upcoming bicycle lane connections, and traffic-calming measures.
